verdict.rationale: Relay explicitly advertises building a cash cushion with high-yield accounts and automated rules (relay-docs-6), and community evidence corroborates automated money partitioning with extra interest on allocated funds (relay-comm-1). However, there's no detail on the actual yield rate, how automated transfer rules are configured, or independent verification of the high-yield claim beyond a general mention. Missing for 10: specifics on the yield rate/APY, configuration details for automated transfer rules, and stronger independent corroboration of the high-yield feature's real-world performance.
